column1: # [UCP] U2 THE ROUTE MANIFEST (tests/ucp/run_ctxnode_tests.sh §3): every pattern of
# population VM-routed with lookaround as the only DFA-excluding construct),
# compiled `--features all` with captures ON (the default), and the engine it
# takes with T3 live (`default`) and denied (`denied`). A row whose default is
# "dfa" is a U2 MOVER (VM -> DFA); every other row stays on the VM — a capture
# in the pattern, a body wider than one character, or a non-ASCII set under
# -e utf8 (§2.3). Generated by the lane from the mover census; a change to it
# is a route change to REVIEW, not a number to bump.
